title: Language and Weather
author: Felix Sterling
blurb: Theo Montrose, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
